title: add an optional total to the shared pagination contract and control
acceptance: PaginationMetaSchema exposes an optional integer total, and a reply that omits it still validates
@repo/ui/table-pagination accepts an optional total and renders a total-aware page label when one is supplied
TablePagination falls back to its current hasNextPage behaviour and page label when no total is supplied
TablePagination disables the next control on the final page when a total is supplied
packages/ui tests cover the with-total and without-total rendering paths and the athletes page renders unchanged
the regenerated OpenAPI document and API client are committed in this phase, so CI's check:generated finds no diff
notes: Additive on both sides so the published /v1/athletes contract does not break. The influencers page needs the total for the mockup's result count and page-of-N label.
